# Guide to FAIR

## Overview

As part of the Bioconductor community, we develop and maintain open-source software, data, and training resources.
By applying the [FAIR principles](https://www.go-fair.org/fair-principles/) -- Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable -- this guide will cover practices and resources supporting users and developers in making those resources easier to discover, access, integrate, and reuse within and beyond the [Bioconductor](https://www.bioconductor.org/) ecosystem.
The following sections describe processes, resources, and checklists for producing FAIR Bioconductor tools, wrappers and workflows, including integrations with other software ecosystems.
